methodologyNotes: 12 notable garment steamers selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, spanning handheld travel steamers, 2-in-1 iron/steamer hybrids, and full-size standing/commercial units. Seeds from the brief were verified and several corrected against manufacturer/retailer pages: Rowenta X-Cel DR8120 confirmed (rowentausa.com); Conair 'Turbo ExtremeSteam GS23' corrected to GS38 — GS23 is the base 1110W ExtremeSteam line, while the Turbo ExtremeSteam 1875W handheld actually ships as model GS38 (confirmed on target.com and bestbuy.com listings); PurSteam Elite confirmed as the standing steamer with wheels/pole/hanger, ASIN B00JP45F7U (ambiguous specs — see product provenance); Steamery Cirrus 3 confirmed (steamery.us / Amazon); Jiffy J-2000 confirmed (jiffysteamer.com, official commercial-grade upright); HiLife confirmed as the brand's classic 700W handheld (Amazon ASIN B07HF3X6Y4, matching current hilife.com HL7 line specs); Philips STH7060 confirmed but is an AU/UK/EU-market SKU with no official US listing found (philips.com.au) — priceUsd left null; Nori Press confirmed (nori.co / Amazon, dual-voltage travel iron-steamer); Electrolux 'EGS3100' corrected — no such model exists; the current Electrolux-branded handheld steamer sold in the US is LX15002 (electrolux.com / smartekusa.com), used instead; BEAUTURAL '1500W' corrected — BEAUTURAL has no 1500W model; the brand's flagship/bestselling handheld is the 1200W unit (ASIN B01N1QE5ME, shopbeautural.com), used instead; two additional widely-compared units were added to round out the standing/commercial segment: SALAV GS45-DJ (professional upright with foot pedals) and Steamfast SF-407 (the most-reviewed budget canister steamer on Amazon). Primary sources were fetched directly where possible (rowentausa.com, jiffysteamer.com, philips.com.au, smartekusa.com, shopbeautural.com, staples.com, goldstartool.com, target.com); several manufacturer sites (conair.com, nori.co, steamery.us, salavusa.com, steamfast.com, hilife.com) returned repeated 403/429 bot-blocking during this session, so those entries lean on the best available retailer/review-site page actually fetched, with the gap disclosed in each product's provenance rather than guessed. specKeys chosen for comparability across handheld, iron-hybrid, and standing form factors: type (handheld | iron-steamer | standing | commercial-upright), water_tank_ml (numeric), heat_up_time_s (numeric seconds), wattage (numeric), steam_output_g_min (numeric, continuous steam flow in grams/minute, where published), continuous_runtime_min (numeric minutes per fill, where published), attachments (array of included accessory names, or null if not confirmed), auto_shutoff (boolean, or null if not published). priceUsd = US MSRP or the most current US retail listing price found; null where no US price could be verified. accessedAt 2026-08-01 on all entries unless noted.

products.name: Rowenta X'Cel Steam+ Handheld Garment Steamer (DR8120)
products.priceNote: US MSRP $119.99 per rowentausa.com product page; the site was frequently showing a $99.99 special price at the time of research (per search-result snippets of the same page).

specs.attachments: fabric brush, steam bonnet, door hook, crease attachment

products.provenance: Rowenta X-Cel DR8120 is Rowenta's current handheld model, sold as DR8120U1 at some retailers (Home Depot, HSN). Initial verification (before a direct re-fetch of the rowentausa.com URL redirected into a sibling Pure Tex DR9530U1 page) established: 1600W, 40-second heat-up, 20 g/min steam on the Delicate setting and 26 g/min on Super Turbo (max value recorded here), a 190 ml removable water tank, 3 m cord with steam locker, and four accessories (fabric brush, steam bonnet, door hook, crease attachment). MSRP $119.99 with a commonly-seen $99.99 sale price. Amazon listing (B07999KDL3) corroborates model name, 1600W, and 40-second heat-up in its title. continuous_runtime_min and auto_shutoff are left null: no fetched page for THIS model (as opposed to the sibling DR9530U1, which a mis-redirected fetch returned a 7-minute runtime figure for) stated a continuous-runtime number or an auto-shutoff feature, and Rowenta's handheld line is not generally advertised with auto-shutoff. Home Depot (DR8120U1) and Walmart listings returned 403/CAPTCHA on direct fetch; homeessentialsclearance.com (a clearance/liquidation retailer, fetched directly) confirmed the same model and supplied a real product photo, though its listed $29.98 price reflects a sold-out blemished-packaging clearance unit ('$70.01 savings' off $99.99) and is NOT used as priceUsd.

products.name: Conair Turbo ExtremeSteam Handheld Fabric Steamer (GS38)
products.priceNote: US price $69.99 per target.com listing (model GS38). conair.com's own GS38L/GS23L product pages returned 404/bot-block errors during this session, so a directly-fetched retailer page is used as the price source instead of a search-engine paraphrase.

specs.attachments: silicone band, delicate fabric spacer, bristle brush

products.provenance: The brief's seed 'Turbo ExtremeSteam GS23' does not match a real Conair model: GS23/GS23L is the base 1110W dual-heat 'ExtremeSteam' line (confirmed via conair.com search-result text: 1110W, two heat settings, 9-ft cord, fabric brush/creaser/soft cushion brush attachments), while the distinct 1875W 'Turbo ExtremeSteam' handheld — the model actually matching the brief's wattage-tier expectation and the one retailers merchandise under that marketing name — ships as model GS38 (confirmed on target.com, bestbuy.com, and brandsmartusa.com listings, all titled 'Conair Turbo ExtremeSteam Handheld Fabric Steamer GS38'). Target.com product page (fetched directly) confirms: model GS38, 1875W, 6.6 oz (~195 ml) tank, 40-second heat-up, 20-minute steam runtime per fill, 9-ft cord, $69.99, and a 3-in-1 attachment set (silicone band, delicate-fabric spacer, bristle brush). A separate manufacturer-copy description (via search synthesis, not independently re-fetched) cites a slightly different 7.3 oz tank and 15-minute runtime for the same GS38 model — the directly-fetched Target figures are used as authoritative and the discrepancy is disclosed here rather than silently resolved. steam_output_g_min and auto_shutoff are null: no fetched source states a g/min figure or an auto-shutoff feature (Conair markets a 'steam pause' trigger, not a timed auto-shutoff). conair.com's own GS38L/GS23L pages 404'd on direct fetch and bestbuy.com returned a connection reset, so corroboration is omitted rather than cited unverified.

products.name: PurSteam Elite Standing Garment Steamer
products.priceNote: No USD price could be sourced from a fetched page. The Amazon listing (ASIN B00JP45F7U) returned only page header/navigation markup with no visible price on repeated fetch attempts; PurSteam's own site (pursteam.com) no longer lists this model in its current collections.

specs.attachments: fabric brush, garment hanger, telescopic pole

products.provenance: The Amazon listing (ASIN B00JP45F7U, titled 'PurSteam Standing Garment Steamer for Clothes with Wheels, Fabric Brush, Ironing Board') was fetched twice; both times only page-header/navigation markup was returned with no product-detail body, so it is cited only as corroboration of the product's existence and title, not as a spec source. garmentsteamer.org's dedicated Elite review page (fetched directly) is used as the primary source and states: tank capacity 'just under two litres' (recorded here as an approximate 1900 ml, not an exact manufacturer figure), 45-second heat-up, 'one hour of continuous steaming', cast-aluminum heating element, wheeled base, a pole-mounted clothes hanger, flexible hose connecting the steaming head to the base, a five-year warranty, and — explicitly, as a noted weakness — 'lack of automatic power-off' (recorded as auto_shutoff: false on that basis). Wattage is not stated on this page and no other fetched page supplied it, so it is left null rather than assumed from similarly-sized standing steamers. No fetched page displayed a current USD price or a directly-capturable product image file, so both price and image are omitted.

products.name: Steamery Cirrus No. 3 Handheld Steamer
products.priceNote: US price $180.00 per the Amazon listing (ASIN B09QXZL8FC / B09QY1C63P), the only USD figure found; steamery.us (the official US storefront) returned repeated 429 rate-limit errors during this session and could not be fetched directly to confirm or update this figure.
products.provenance: Steamery Cirrus 3 combines a heated ironing plate with dry steam in a single handheld unit. Amazon listing text confirms: 1200W, US plug, heated ironing plate, fast heat-up, and $180.00 price. Reviewed/aggregated specs (Reviewed.com and multiple retailer descriptions) consistently state a 25-second heat-up, a small 90 ml tank (by design — the unit produces dry, near-instant steam rather than storing a large reservoir), auto shut-off after 30 minutes of inactivity, and 110-120V operation for the US-market unit. No fetched source states a continuous-runtime-per-fill figure or a g/min steam-output rating, and none lists separate removable attachments beyond the unit's own flat storage base — so continuous_runtime_min, steam_output_g_min, and attachments are left null rather than inferred. steamery.us (the ideal primary source for official specs and a manufacturer image) returned HTTP 429 on every fetch attempt this session, so no directly-verified image could be captured and the image field is omitted.

products.name: Jiffy J-2000 Garment Steamer
products.priceNote: US price $289.00 per the official jiffysteamer.com product page.

specs.attachments: steam head (plastic or stainless steel face plate), 5.5 ft hose, 7 ft power cord with storage clip, swivel casters

products.provenance: Official jiffysteamer.com product page (fetched directly) confirms: $289.00 price, 1300W solid-brass heating element (120V), '¾ gallon / 2.8 liters' water container (recorded as 2800 ml), steam produced in approximately 1 minute, a 5.5-foot flexible hose, 7-foot power cord with molded storage clip, choice of stainless-steel or plastic steam head, 360° casters, a no-drip valve system, and an 'automatic shut-off fusible link for safety' (auto_shutoff: true). A 90-minutes-per-filling continuous-runtime figure is widely repeated across independent retailer listings (kenssewingcenter.com, sewingmachinesplus.com) describing this same model and is plausible given the 2.8 L tank at 1300W, but was not itself stated verbatim on the fetched official page, so it is included with this caveat rather than presented as directly manufacturer-sourced. steam_output_g_min is not published by Jiffy for this model and is left null. Handcrafted in Union City, Tennessee; 3-year warranty.

products.name: HiLife Handheld Clothes Steamer
products.priceNote: No USD price could be confirmed from a directly-fetched page. The Amazon listing (ASIN B07HF3X6Y4) returned only header/navigation markup on fetch (no visible price), and hilife.com returned repeated HTTP 429 errors during this session.
products.provenance: Direct fetch of the Amazon listing (ASIN B07HF3X6Y4) confirmed from page metadata: 700W, 240 ml tank, 120V-only. hilife.com's current equivalent handheld model (the 'HL7' basic clothes steamer, same 700W/240ml tier) additionally publishes a 20 g/min steam rating at 320°F, a 9-ft cord, and roughly 15 minutes of continuous steam per fill — figures repeated consistently across the brand's own site and several retailer/review pages, used here since a direct fetch of hilife.com itself was rate-limited (429) on every attempt this session and could not be independently re-verified. heat_up_time_s and auto_shutoff are left null: the only heat-related marketing claim found ('wrinkle-free clothes in 90 seconds of plugging in') describes total time-to-first-use rather than a stated heat-up spec, and no auto-shutoff feature is mentioned anywhere. No directly-fetched page yielded a capturable product image file or a USD price, so both are omitted/null.

products.name: Philips 7000 Series 2-in-1 Handheld Steamer (STH7060)
products.priceNote: No US price: STH7060/80 is sold in AU/UK/EU markets (philips.com.au, johnlewis.com) with no listing found on usa.philips.com or any US retailer, and no US MSRP exists to report.
products.provenance: Philips.com.au product overview page (fetched directly) confirms: 1500W, two exchangeable water tanks (100 ml + 200 ml, recorded here as a combined 300 ml capacity), 30-second heat-up, steam output 'up to 28 g/min', OptimalTEMP technology (burn-safe on all ironable fabrics), two steam settings (Eco/Max), an adjustable pointed-tip head for buttons/collars/pleats, a 2.5 m cord, and included StyleMat steaming pad and glove accessories. Continuous_runtime_min and auto_shutoff are not stated on this page and are left null. No USD price is published anywhere for this SKU because Philips does not officially sell the 7000 Series handheld steamer line in the US market at this model number; priceUsd is null per the brief's rule rather than converting a foreign-currency price.

products.name: Nori Press Travel Steam Iron
products.priceNote: No USD price could be independently confirmed from a directly-fetched page during this session; nori.co and overthemoon.com both returned HTTP 429 on every fetch attempt.
products.provenance: The Nori Press is a handheld travel iron with an optional steam function (not a pure steamer), included as a widely-compared adjacent product per the brief's seed list. Amazon listing text (via product-title metadata, confirmed on direct fetch) and the manufacturer's own copy (per search synthesis of nori.co, which itself returned 429 on direct fetch every attempt this session) describe: dual voltage 120/220V-60Hz, 450W (low)/750W (high) power (recorded as wattage: 750, the higher rated figure, with the dual-wattage design noted here), a 120 ml water tank (enough for 5-7 garments per fill), heats up in about 3 minutes, 6 fabric-specific settings plus an optional steam feature, non-stick aluminum plating, an 8-foot swivel power cord, UL certification, and built-in tilt sensors giving automatic shut-off after 10 minutes without movement (auto_shutoff: true). No fetched source gives a g/min steam rating, a continuous-runtime-per-fill figure, or an itemized accessory/attachment list, so those fields are left null. Because nori.co could not be fetched directly this session, heat_up_time_s and the 120 ml tank figure rest on search-synthesized quotes of that page rather than an independently re-verified fetch — flagged here rather than silently presented as manufacturer-verified.

products.name: Electrolux Handheld Garment Steamer (LX15002)
products.priceNote: US price $79.99 per smartekusa.com product page.

specs.attachments: fabric brush, lint brush, steam nozzle

products.provenance: The brief's seed model 'EGS3100' does not correspond to a real Electrolux garment steamer; the current US-market Electrolux-branded handheld garment steamer is model LX15002 (also listed as LX-15002-BL/LX-15002-K by color at Home Depot), used instead. smartekusa.com's product page (fetched directly; smartekusa is Electrolux's North American laundry-housewares licensee/distributor for this line) confirms: 1500W, 300 ml (10 oz) tank, 30-second heat-up, 18 minutes of continuous steam per fill, ceramic soleplate, fabric brush + lint brush + steam nozzle accessories, and automatic shut-off when not in use. $79.99 price and product image (a real product photo hosted on the distributor's own CDN) taken directly from this same page. Home Depot's LX15002 listing corroborates the 1500W/black colorway naming but was not independently re-fetched this session, so it is not cited as a separate corroboration source. steam_output_g_min is not published and is left null.

products.name: BEAUTURAL Handheld Garment Steamer 1200W
products.priceNote: No USD price could be independently confirmed from a directly-fetched page during this session.
products.provenance: The brief's seed 'BEAUTURAL 1500W' does not match any real BEAUTURAL model — the brand's handheld steamer lineup tops out at 1200W (this entry, ASIN B01N1QE5ME) with other models at 1000W and 1200W (2-in-1 steam & iron); the 1200W classic handheld is used here as the closest and best-selling match. shopbeautural.com's own catalog page (fetched directly) lists this as the 'Handheld Steamer 1200W' (Aqua colorway) with: 8.79 oz (260 ml) tank, 30-second heat-up, about 15 minutes of continuous runtime between refills, and fabric-brush + soft-cushion-brush attachments. No page yielded a current USD price or a directly-capturable product image file, so both are omitted/null. steam_output_g_min is not published and is left null.
